subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should this issue require both a runtime overflow-decision fix and persisted compaction trigger metadata before it can close, or should the trigger metadata be split into a narrower diagnostics follow-up?
rationale: The runtime bug is clear enough to keep open, but adding a typed persisted compaction cause changes transcript schema and diagnostics policy, which automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Fix Runtime And Metadata
options.body: Keep this issue open until the low-context compaction trigger is fixed and compaction entries carry a stable trigger/cause field.

options.title: Split Metadata Follow-up
options.body: Use this issue for the premature-compaction fix only and track compaction trigger metadata in a separate diagnostics issue.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Pause implementation until a current-main yielded-parent/subagent wake repro is captured with runtime logs.

recommendation.title: Fix Runtime And Metadata
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the low-context compaction trigger is fixed and compaction entries carry a stable trigger/cause field.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent context-engine and preflight overflow budgeting work makes this the best available owner for the compaction-policy decision.
